key_patterns: OWNER: OverlayService.LiveVideoRuntimePorts (nested, implements VideoInstallationRuntimePorts + MediaCalendarScheduler.Sink) is the real principal runtime owner: pending/active/retiring Activation records, a fresh unique token per ARM (even same-revision), presentation generation captured ONCE after SceneRuntimeController.replaceRevision, invalidate()-before-retire, matching(token) honoring only the active activation, selectActiveRevision() as the final ARM/promotion step, abortActivation() bounded cleanup retrying clear even on native refusal. Phase C must EXTRACT/REUSE this activation mechanic under a single common owner and add STATIC Video+Banner ports; it must NOT create a competing LiveBanner owner. CONTROLLER: SceneRuntimeController is Android-free, clock-free, generation-guarded (onEventDue/onEventExpired(id, callbackGeneration) ignore stale generation), one-visual-scene, preflight-before-show; reusable for Banner. Its `eligible` flag survives loads, so WALL must explicitly initialize local eligibility after promotion and re-evaluate the current window on regain/suspension (sections 6, 22). HANDLER: InstallationHandler impls (see VideoManifestInstallationHandler) do validate/prepare/encodeForCache/restoreFromCache/arm with ZERO persistence/runtime/render/ACK side effects before commit; InstallationHandlerRegistry is static, max 2 entries, codec-gated by TvCapabilities.current().supportedCodecs(). CAPABILITY: TvCapabilities.current() advertises MEDIA only and supportsWallClockExecution()==false; a truthful WALL capability flip is only legitimate after the full qualified path exists (section 1) and is NOT a Phase C deliverable to flip for production. PURE WALL CORE: app/.../wall/{WallEvent,WallCalendar,WallCalendarScheduler}.java are JDK-pure, payload-free, read no clock, schedule nothing (enforced by tests/test_m6_phase_b_boundary.py forbidding android.*/System./Handler/etc. imports); the Phase C Android WALL driver (sampling System.currentTimeMillis + SystemClock.elapsedRealtime, single bounded postDelayed wait, drift/reanchor, wallGeneration, timer ticket) MUST live OUTSIDE the pure wall/ package so the purity gate still passes, and MUST NOT modify the Phase B scheduler to keep it payload-free. DIAGNOSTICS: RuntimeDiagnostics enums + DiagnosticsStore observational setters + DiagnosticsActivity view; WALL taxonomy (section 15): NONE, WALL_CALENDAR_LOADED, WALL_ANCHORED, WALL_EVENT_DUE, WALL_EVENT_EXPIRED, WALL_EVENT_SUPERSEDED, WALL_CLOCK_REEVALUATED, WALL_CALENDAR_CLEARED, WALL_HORIZON_EXHAUSTED, WALL_DISPLAY_SUSPENDED, WALL_CLOCK_INVALID, WALL_DEADLINE_FAILED (observational only, never gate selection/clock/ACK, never carry content/token/credential/eventId/URL/payload). AUTOSTART: AutostartPolicy.decide + BootReceiver.decide currently require MediaSession/Notification access even for a cache; Phase C adds a bounded decision for a KNOWN Banner codec/handler snapshot: opt-in + overlay + durable present, WITHOUT MediaSession grant, receiver still reads only metadata (section 12). INSTALLER/STORE REUSE: InstallationStore/InstallationSnapshot/InstallationSnapshotCodec/PackageInstaller + corrected SharedPreferences transport are the single durable path; no second store, installer, occurrence journal, or anchor persistence. RESTORE: restoreInstalledPackage reuses the same-revision installer path and ARMs via owner ports; restore creates a FRESH temporal context (no durable anchor/wallGeneration/ticket/cursor).
